exceptions.object: public C-language functions owned by supabase_admin (145 live extension routines)
exceptions.justification: pgvector/pg_trgm extension support routines are SECURITY INVOKER, are not application RPCs, do not perform application authorization or data mutation, and retain Supabase-managed ACLs whose grantor is supabase_admin. The current postgres migration role cannot revoke those grantor ACL entries. They are excluded from privileged application-RPC checks and reported as managed extension residuals.
